- **One assumption:** Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two using the public Jan 2 handoff digest. It says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on Jan 5 and calls it Pree's dealer account before that. I told Pree this and asked Tobias in the thread to confirm.
- **What I couldn't check:** I can't see any account or ticket files, so I couldn't check #8841 in the ticket system.

A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the channel was fine.
